title: The covering letter, and when it is worth writing one

videos.script: Some application forms have a box for a covering letter. Most people either leave it empty or paste the same five paragraphs into every one. {{box}} Neither is right. A letter is read when it says something the CV cannot, and ignored when it repeats the CV in longer sentences. {{read}} In Brazil it is rarer than in English-speaking countries, and it has a shorter cousin that matters more: the message you send a recruiter on LinkedIn. {{cousin}} This lesson decides when a letter is worth writing, gives it three short paragraphs, and writes the message.
